olivia: Heads-up: after yesterday's package.json tidy the onboarding sample started throwing in the Edge preview: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` during bundle/start.

sam: Which tidy? the one that removed `main` and only left conditional `exports`? paste the package.json and the exact error.

olivia: Error trace (condensed): ```SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'
 at new Script (vm.js:85:7)
 at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:1158:28)
```
package.json: ```{"name":"@redwood/sample-sdk","version":"0.3.0","exports":{"./feature":{"import":"./dist/feature.mjs","require":"./dist/feature.cjs"}},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}```

kevin: Yup that's the change. Edge/bundlers sometimes resolve to the import entry for subpath imports unless you declare the package root and `./package.json` in exports. That breaks CJS consumers that do `require('@redwood/sample-sdk/feature')`.

maria: Also TypeScript + monorepo tooling: if someone imports `@redwood/sample-sdk/feature` for types only, tsc can still find `./feature.d.ts` if present, but when runtime pulls `.mjs` in a CJS process you get runtime syntax errors.

olivia: Repro steps: checkout sample-app, `node -v` 16.14.2 locally passed, but our edge preview image (edge-runtime) fails in CI. CI details: `ci-bot` flagged sample-app matrix: node16/edge latest.

ci-bot: CI sample-app / integration 026-03-18 0: failed in edge-worker (3/3). See internal link.

sam: Immediate mitigation: add a root export with both import/require, and explicit `./package.json` export to help older tools. Proposed exports: ```{".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./package.json":"./package.json","./feature":{"import":"./dist/feature.mjs","require":"./dist/feature.cjs"}}```

kevin: + ship both artifacts in the tarball and keep `main`/`module` fallback fields for older bundlers. e.g. "main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs". Some packagers and older `require()` consumers still look at `main`.

maria: For types, keep `"types":"dist/index.d.ts"` and include `dist/feature.d.ts` next to compiled files. Also add a small test that `require()` and `import()` both work in a minimal consumer.

olivia: I'll open a quick patch that adds the root export, `./package.json` export, `main`/`module`, and ensure `npm pack` includes both cjs/mjs and d.ts files. I'll run `npm pack` locally and test against the sample-app and edge preview image.

kevin: Long-term action: add an exports-change checklist in devex docs: run smoke tests on Node 12/14/16/18, Bun, edge runtime, `npm pack` verification, and a minimal CJS and ESM consumption example. Also add CI job that installs from `npm pack` artifact and runs sample-app matrix.

sam: Also update the onboarding docs to show both `const sdk = require('@redwood/sample-sdk')` and `import sdk from '@redwood/sample-sdk'` patterns so users know both are supported.

ci-bot: PR opening triggered: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/689 026-03-18 09:12  - smoke tests queued for edge matrix.

maria: One more edge case: some bundlers follow exports but ignore `./package.json`. Explicit export prevents them from attempting to resolve package metadata via filesystem, which some tools expect.

olivia: Will validate with `node --experimental-modules` variants and the edge preview image. I'll report back here once CI finishes. Thanks. :+1:
